title: Variable-Lattice-Density Optimization of Pin-Fin Heat Sinks under High-Reynolds-Number Flow Conditions
summary: This study extends variable-lattice-density optimization to high-Reynolds-number flows for the design of periodically arranged pin-fin heat sinks. Effective permeability and drag coefficient are identified from unit-cell Reynolds-averaged Navier--Stokes analyses of cylindrical pin-fin arrays and incorporated into a reduced model based on the Darcy--Forchheimer law for macroscopic design exploration.
